releaseState: Local candidate qualified; the deterministic Ask AI and project-strip composition repair is not deployed by this audit.

contentPurpose.evidence: The first viewport clearly identifies a no-sign-up, browser-local Domain Rating tracker for shared examples and the visitor's own sites. The page is the working tool rather than a separate marketing shell.

designQuality.evidence: The dense dashboard is coherent and responsive at 390 and 1440 pixels with zero horizontal overflow or console errors. Its extreme mobile length is acceptable for a P4 data tool, not a migration reason.

seo.evidence: The candidate passes all critical title, description, canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD, heading, leak, and link checks. Advisory only: the app-like page has no h2 and about 267 words. Production link graph crawled 3 pages with zero internal errors, redirects, or orphans.

geo.evidence: Production agent-index audit is S-tier 100 with readable llms.txt, /api/ai, homepage Markdown, robots, sitemap, JSON-LD, and complete catalog integrity.

performance.evidence: PSI Swarm completed 20/20 serial audits. Mobile-mid p75 LCP was 0.840 s, mobile-fast 0.482 s, desktop 0.291 s, and the harsh mobile-slow profile 1.634 s; CLS was 0.030 and mobile-mid TBT 45 ms. The only material advisory was unused JavaScript in the Next.js client bundle.
